observable: Transducer array element failure rate per 1000 hours of operation
baseline: Current transducer array element failure rate per 1000 hours of operation (average of 5 previous prototypes)
conditions: Nucleus embedded between transducer array elements and imaging electronics, thermal-mechanical coupling mechanism activated, and transducer array elements subjected to 1000 hours of continuous operation at 50°C
falsifier: Failure rate per 1000 hours of operation increases by more than 10% compared to the baseline, or the thermal-mechanical coupling mechanism is found to be ineffective in experimental data or simulations
